title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Response Policy Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned RFC 9464 provisioning response-policy helpers above the ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO codecs.
planned_changes:
- Add `EncryptedDnsProvisioningResponder`, `EncryptedDnsProvisioningResponse`, and `EncryptedDnsProvisioningResponseOptions`.
- Support zero-length CFG_REQUEST support advertisements for IPv4, IPv6, or both.
- Accept specific resolver suggestions in requests while allowing responder policy to ignore them.
- Ignore identical duplicate request attributes and optionally discard requests past a repeated-attribute threshold.
- Select CFG_REPLY configurations by supported address family, require at least one returned IP address, prefer `alpn`, and order multiple replies by service priority.
- Optionally include CFG_REPLY ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused provisioning responder tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Full IKEv2 Configuration payload exchange state machine.
Operating-system resolver provisioning and split-tunnel policy.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9464 request/reply policy floor that future IKEv2 or ProtocolLab provisioning integration can consume.
